#umap


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(umap)
library(patchwork)

zeta <- read_csv("H:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/zeta_dir.csv")
Trialless <- read_csv("H:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/wrangled_Data/R_outputs/Trialless.csv")

list_of_ptt <- list.files(
  path = "H:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/peak_to_trough_times",
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
ptt <- read_csv(list_of_ptt, id = "id2") %>% as_tibble()

# keys to match the names of the Neruopixels data to the shortfrom M{id}_{session}
translator <- read_csv2("H:/Florian_paper/Florian/Aligned_Data/Analysable_data/translator.csv")

ptt2 <- ptt %>%
  separate(Original_Index, into = c("old", "second_part"), sep = "(?=_row)", extra = "merge", remove = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(translator) %>%
  select(second_part:new) %>%
  select(!Folder) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(second_part, delim = "_", names = c("d1", "d2", "cluster_id")) %>%
  select(cluster_id:new) %>%
  rename(id = new) %>%
  mutate(cluster_id = as.numeric(cluster_id)) %>%
  filter(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` > 0.16)

Trialless <- Trialless %>%
  left_join(ptt2 %>% unite("cluster_id2", cluster_id, id)) %>%
  replace_na(list(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` = 0)) %>%
  mutate(newgroup = ifelse(`Peak_to_Valley (ms)` == 0, group, "FS")) %>%
  filter(group != "noise") %>%
  select(Behv:Zscore, newgroup, `Peak_to_Valley (ms)`) %>%
  filter(newgroup != "noise")



zeta2 <- zeta %>%
  unite("cluster_id", unit, Mouse, Day) %>%
  filter(cluster_id %in% Trialless$cluster_id2) %>%
  mutate(Behv = ifelse(Behv == "PC", "UA", Behv)) %>%
  mutate(dircat = ifelse(direction > 0, "increase", "decrease")) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  mutate(dircat = ifelse(p_adj > 0.05, "no_change", dircat))
```

#A
```{r}
zeta_u <- zeta2 %>%
  filter(Behv == "A2L") %>%
  filter(p_value < 0.05) %>%
  pull(cluster_id)
AA <- Trialless %>%
  filter(cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u) %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, 0, 0.500)) %>%
  filter(Behv %in% c("A2L")) %>%
  group_by(rel_time, cluster_id2) %>%
  summarise(Zscore = mean(Zscore)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
  mutate(Zscore = zoo::rollmean.default(Zscore, 20, "extend")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
  mutate(norm = Zscore) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-Zscore) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = rel_time, values_from = norm)



AA <- AA %>% na.omit()
AA.data <- AA %>% select(-cluster_id2)
AA.data <- t(scale(t(AA.data)))

AA.labels <- AA %>% select(cluster_id2)

# 1. Dimensionality Reduction (Existing)
pca <- prcomp(AA.data, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)
plot(cumsum(pca$sdev[1:10]^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)))
plot(cumsum(pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)))
AA.pca <- pca$x[, 1:5] # Top 5 PCs

# 2. K-means Clustering
# Set your desired number of clusters (e.g., k = 5)
k_centers <- 4
set
cl <- kmeans(AA.pca, centers = k_centers, nstart = 25)

# 3. Dimensionality Reduction for Visualization (Existing)
AA.umap <- umap(AA.pca, n_components = 2)

# 4. Prepare Plotting Data
plotda <- tibble(
  UMAP1 = AA.umap$layout[, 1],
  UMAP2 = AA.umap$layout[, 2],
  cluster = factor(cl$cluster), # K-means cluster assignment
  cluster_id2 = AA.labels$cluster_id2
)

# Visualize Clusters in UMAP space
plotda <- plotda %>% mutate(cluster = as.factor(cluster))
ggplot(plotda, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, col = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "K-means Clusters in UMAP Space")
# ggsave('C:/users/Freitag/Desktop/clusteview.svg')


# 5. Join and Plot Temporal Profiles
filt_kmean <- plotda %>%
  select(cluster_id2, kmc = cluster)

# Calculate counts for the facet labels
counts_df <- filt_kmean %>%
  count(kmc)

Trialless %>% filter(Behv == "A2L") %>% 
  filter(cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u) %>%
  left_join(filt_kmean, by = "cluster_id2") %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, -0.05, 1)) %>%
  group_by(rel_time, kmc) %>%
  summarise(Zscore = mean(Zscore), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(rel_time, Zscore, col = as.factor(kmc))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.1, se = FALSE, size = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~kmc, scales = "free") +
  geom_text(
    data = counts_df,
    aes(label = paste0("n = ", n)),
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    size = 4
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Mean Z-score", col = "Cluster")

# ggsave('C:/users/Freitag/Desktop/meanview.svg')



p1 <- ggplot(plotda, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, col = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "K-means Clusters in UMAP Space")



# P2 20 ms bins
n_cat <- Trialless %>%
  filter(cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u) %>%
  left_join(filt_kmean, by = "cluster_id2") %>%
  distinct(cluster_id2, kmc) %>%
  count(kmc)
p2 <- Trialless %>% filter(Behv == "A2L") %>% 
  filter(cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u) %>%
  left_join(filt_kmean, by = "cluster_id2") %>%
  filter(between(rel_time, 0, 1)) %>%
  mutate(rel_time = floor(rel_time / 0.020) * 0.020) %>%
  group_by(rel_time, kmc, cluster_id2) %>%
  summarise(Zscore = mean(Zscore)) %>%
  left_join(n_cat) %>%
  na.omit() %>% distinct(rel_time,kmc,Zscore,n) %>% 
  group_by(rel_time, kmc) %>%
  summarise(m_Zscore = mean(Zscore), sd = sd(Zscore), sem = sd / sqrt(first(n)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  distinct(rel_time, kmc, m_Zscore, sd, sem) %>%
  ggplot(aes(rel_time, m_Zscore, )) +
  geom_line(aes(col = as.factor(kmc)), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = m_Zscore - sem, ymax = m_Zscore + sem, fill = kmc), alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~kmc, scales = "free") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Mean Z-score", col = "Cluster") +
  guides(color = "none")

p2 <- p2 +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    # axis lines
    axis.line.x = element_line(),
    axis.line.y = element_line(),

    # ticks
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(),

    # text
    axis.text.y = element_text(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(),

    # tick length (optional, makes them visible)
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.15, "cm")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1))
p2

pp <- (p1 + p2) + plot_layout(, widths = c(1.8, 1))

#pp_old<- pp

pp
pp_old #seed 404

ggsave("F:/Berlin/figures_v2/Final/Raw_plots_v2/UMAP_fig/A_2.svg", width = 16, height = 9)
```

#validation


```{r}
# Assumes zeta_u, AA.data, AA.labels, and pca were created above.
# `pca` must have been fitted as:
# pca <- prcomp(AA.data, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)

time_window <- c(0, 0.5)   # Same window used for PCA/UMAP
pc_threshold <- 0.95
n_folds <- 10

set.seed(404)



#recalculate features to have the same max duration as the PCA input, this essentially changes nothing

int100 <- Trialless %>%
  filter(
    cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u,
    Behv == "A2L",
    between(rel_time, 0, 0.1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
  summarise(
    int100 = sum(Zscore) * 0.01,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

intsus <- Trialless %>%
  filter(
    cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u,
    Behv == "A2L",
    between(rel_time, 0.1, 0.4)
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
  summarise(
    intsus = sum(Zscore) * 0.01,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ttp <- Trialless %>%
  filter(
    cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u,
    Behv == "A2L",
    between(rel_time, time_window[1], time_window[2])
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = Zscore,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    ttp = first(rel_time),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pma <- Trialless %>%
  filter(
    cluster_id2 %in% zeta_u,
    Behv == "A2L",
    between(rel_time, time_window[1], time_window[2])
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id2) %>%
  summarise(
    pma = max(Zscore),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

features <- int100 %>%
  left_join(intsus, by = "cluster_id2") %>%
  left_join(ttp, by = "cluster_id2") %>%
  left_join(pma, by = "cluster_id2")

feature_names <- c("int100", "intsus", "ttp", "pma")

# Match features to the existing PCA/PSTH rows
analysis_ids <- AA.labels %>%
  left_join(features, by = "cluster_id2") %>%
  drop_na(all_of(feature_names))

row_keep <- match(analysis_ids$cluster_id2, AA.labels$cluster_id2)

AA.model <- AA.data[row_keep, , drop = FALSE]
X <- analysis_ids %>%
  select(all_of(feature_names)) %>%
  as.matrix()

stopifnot(!anyNA(row_keep))

# Use the PCA already fitted above.
# This is valid provided all AA.data rows have the four feature values.
stopifnot(nrow(AA.model) == nrow(AA.data))

pc_prop_var <- pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)
n_pc <- which(cumsum(pc_prop_var) >= pc_threshold)[1]

pc_scores <- pca$x[, seq_len(n_pc), drop = FALSE]
pc_rotation <- pca$rotation[, seq_len(n_pc), drop = FALSE]

X_scaled <- scale(X) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# In-sample reconstruction from the four features
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fitted_scores <- map_dfc(seq_len(n_pc), function(j) {
# see notes below about using a LM here 
  fit <- lm(
    pc_scores[, j] ~ int100 + intsus + ttp + pma,
    data = X_scaled
  )

  tibble(PC = fitted(fit))
}) %>%
  as.matrix()

psth_pred_in_sample <- fitted_scores %*% t(pc_rotation)

R2_in_sample <- 1 -
  sum((AA.model - psth_pred_in_sample)^2) / sum(AA.model^2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Feature-alone and unique contributions, in-sample
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# This essentially shows that there is a big overlap in the features because the Feature alone is often way bigger than their unqiue contribution
reconstruction_R2 <- function(predictors) {

  fitted_scores <- map_dfc(seq_len(n_pc), function(j) {

    fit <- lm(
      reformulate(predictors, response = "score"),
      data = bind_cols(
        X_scaled,
        tibble(score = pc_scores[, j])
      )
    )

    tibble(PC = fitted(fit))
  }) %>%
    as.matrix()

  psth_pred <- fitted_scores %*% t(pc_rotation)

  1 - sum((AA.model - psth_pred)^2) / sum(AA.model^2)
}

feature_results <- map_dfr(feature_names, function(feature) {

  R2_alone <- reconstruction_R2(feature)

  R2_without <- reconstruction_R2(
    setdiff(feature_names, feature)
  )

  tibble(
    feature = feature,
    variance_explained_alone_percent = 100 * R2_alone,
    unique_variance_explained_percent =
      100 * (R2_in_sample - R2_without)
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 1)))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10-fold cross-validation
# PCA and feature scaling are re-fitted within each training set.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(404)

n_neurons <- nrow(AA.model)
fold_id <- sample(rep(seq_len(n_folds), length.out = n_neurons))

psth_pred_cv <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = nrow(AA.model),
  ncol = ncol(AA.model)
)

for (fold in seq_len(n_folds)) {

  train_idx <- which(fold_id != fold)
  test_idx <- which(fold_id == fold)

  psth_train <- AA.model[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  psth_test <- AA.model[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]

  X_train <- scale(X[train_idx, , drop = FALSE])

  X_test <- scale(
    X[test_idx, , drop = FALSE],
    center = attr(X_train, "scaled:center"),
    scale = attr(X_train, "scaled:scale")
  )

  X_train <- as.data.frame(X_train)
  X_test <- as.data.frame(X_test)

  pca_train <- prcomp(
    psth_train,
    center = FALSE,
    scale. = FALSE
  )

  prop_var_train <- pca_train$sdev^2 / sum(pca_train$sdev^2)

  n_pc_train <- which(
    cumsum(prop_var_train) >= pc_threshold
  )[1]

  predicted_scores <- map_dfc(seq_len(n_pc_train), function(j) {

    fit <- lm(
      pca_train$x[, j] ~ int100 + intsus + ttp + pma,
      data = X_train
    )

    tibble(PC = predict(fit, newdata = X_test))
  }) %>%
    as.matrix()

  psth_pred_cv[test_idx, ] <- predicted_scores %*%
    t(pca_train$rotation[, seq_len(n_pc_train), drop = FALSE])
}

R2_cv <- 1 -
  sum((AA.model - psth_pred_cv)^2) / sum(AA.model^2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  "\nPSTH PCA reconstruction\n",
  "------------------------\n",
  "Neurons: ", n_neurons, "\n",
  "PCs retained: ", n_pc, "\n",
  "PSTH variance retained by PCs: ",
  round(100 * sum(pc_prop_var[seq_len(n_pc)]), 1), "%\n",
  "In-sample reconstruction R2: ",
  round(100 * R2_in_sample, 1), "%\n",
  "10-fold cross-validated reconstruction R2: ",
  round(100 * R2_cv, 1), "%\n\n",
  sep = ""
)

feature_results

# Optional feature-contribution plot
feature_results %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      variance_explained_alone_percent,
      unique_variance_explained_percent
    ),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "variance_explained"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure = recode(
      measure,
      variance_explained_alone_percent = "Feature alone",
      unique_variance_explained_percent = "Unique contribution"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(feature, variance_explained, fill = measure)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Variance in normalized PSTHs explained (%)",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```




# I tried the same with GAM,
# at least PC1 shows strong non-linearity
# But GAM only increases R2 slightly (0.548 vs 0.578)
# since this is a secondary analsis and the cross-fold variation is stable, simple LM seems solid enough
